segments.text:
V. 2.
Who ſinned, this man, or his parents, that he was born blind?—That is, was it for his own Sins, or for the Sins of his Parents? They ſuppoſe (as many of the Jews did, tho' without any Ground from Scripture) that he might have ſinned in a pre-exiſtent State, before he came into the World.
